items.title: DSM Auth接口SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者经Auth API注入SQL，读写任意文件或DoS
items.affected: Synology(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至 7.4.1-90080-1 或对应分支修复版
items.repro_note: 未授权访问DSM Auth API，构造SQL注入参数
items.description: An improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command vulnerability in the Auth API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.2.1-69057-13, 7.2.2-72806-10, 7.3.2-86009-5, and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.

items.title: DSM rsync认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者经rsync备用路径绕过认证，读特定文件、写任意文件或DoS
items.affected: Synology(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 访问rsync服务，利用备用路径绕过认证
items.impact_scope: NAS rsync服务，可能暴露公网
items.description: An authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the rsync in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.2.1-69057-13, 7.2.2-72806-10, 7.3.2-86009-5, and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote attackers to read specific files, write arbitrary files, and conduct limited denial-of-service attacks.

items.title: M365 Manager Plus越权RCE
items.summary_zh: 认证技术员利用委派管理权限校验不足，越权并可能远程执行代码
items.affected: ManageEngine(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至 4818 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 以技术员登录委派管理接口，构造越权操作
items.impact_scope: 企业云管理平台，内网高权限
items.description: Zohocorp ManageEngine M365 Manager Plus versions below 4818 is affected by an authenticated technician may exploit insufficient permission validation in the delegated administration interface to escalate privileges beyond their intended scope, which could result in remote code execution during administrative processing.
